people.name: Gilbert John Elliot-Murray-Kynynmound, 4th Earl of Minto
people.nameZh: 第四代明托伯爵吉爾伯特·約翰·埃利奧特—默里—基寧蒙德

body.zh-Hant: 加拿大傳記辭典記載，吉爾伯特·約翰·默里—基寧蒙德·埃利奧特於1845年7月9日生於倫敦，是梅爾貢德子爵威廉·休·默里—基寧蒙德·埃利奧特的長子，1914年3月1日卒於蘇格蘭明托附近。他1859年以梅爾貢德勳爵之名入讀伊頓公學，1863年離開，隔年進劍橋三一學院；1867年畢業後，家人為他買下蘇格蘭燧發槍衛隊的軍官職位。
body.en: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography records that Gilbert John Murray-Kynynmound Elliot was born in London on 9 July 1845, eldest son of William Hugh Murray-Kynynmound Elliot, Viscount Melgund, and died near Minto, Scotland, on 1 March 1914. In 1859, as Lord Melgund, he enrolled at Eton College; he was withdrawn in 1863 and entered Trinity College, Cambridge, the following year. After his graduation in 1867 his family purchased him a commission in the Scots Fusilier Guards.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍旅、加拿大任職與襲爵
heading.en: Army service, Canada and the earldom

body.zh-Hant: 他1882年以騎兵步兵上尉身分隨英軍赴埃及鎮壓阿拉比帕夏。1883年6月蘭斯多恩勛爵提議帶他到渥太華擔任軍事秘書；1885年3月西北叛亂爆發，米德爾頓任命他為參謀長。1886年6月他以自由統一黨身分競選諾森伯蘭一席未果，1891年繼承明托伯爵爵位。
body.en: In 1882 he served as a captain in the Mounted Infantry, part of the British force sent to Egypt to suppress Arabi Pasha. In June 1883 Lord Lansdowne offered to bring him to Ottawa as his military secretary, and when the North-West rebellion broke out in March 1885 Middleton named him chief of staff. In June 1886 he unsuccessfully contested a parliamentary seat in Northumberland for the Liberal Unionists, and he inherited the earldom of Minto in 1891.

body.zh-Hant: 1898年7月25日他獲任命為加拿大總督，同年11月12日就任。1900年1月他發起成立加拿大愛國基金，照顧南非戰爭的加拿大退伍軍人與其家屬。他於1904年11月離開加拿大返英；傳記作者認為，到任期結束時他已成為有經驗、稱職而審慎的總督，可承擔更繁重的帝國任務。
body.en: He was appointed governor general of Canada on 25 July 1898 and assumed office on 12 November. In January 1900 he organized the Canadian Patriotic Fund to help care for Canadian veterans of the South African War and their dependants. He left Canada for Britain in November 1904; the biographer judges that by the end of his term he had become an experienced, capable and judicious governor, ready for more strenuous imperial service.

citations.quote: Minto was appointed on 25 July and assumed office on 12 November.
citations.evidenceNote: 年份依同段上文「In March 1898」推得1898年

body.zh-Hant: 1905年他被任命為印度總督，與印度事務大臣約翰·莫利推行影響深遠的政治改革；Banglapedia記載他1905年11月接替寇松。《印度百科》記他1906年10月1日在西姆拉接見由阿迦汗率領的三十五名穆斯林貴族代表團，莫利—明托改革的成果則是1909年的《印度參事會法》。Banglapedia說他於1910年11月辭職，由哈丁繼任；德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他1905至1910年任印度總督。
body.en: In 1905 he was appointed viceroy of India and, with Secretary of State for India John Morley, implemented far-reaching political reforms. Banglapedia says he succeeded Lord Curzon in November 1905. The Encyclopedia of India records that on 1 October 1906 he received at Simla a delegation of thirty-five Muslim aristocrats led by the Aga Khan, and the Morley-Minto reforms took the shape of the Indian Councils Act of 1909. Banglapedia says he resigned in November 1910 and was succeeded by Lord Hardinge; the German National Library authority file also gives him as viceroy of India for 1905-1910.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與匈牙利時期
heading.en: Origins, studies and the Hungarian period

body.zh-Hant: 捷克外交部的人物條目記載，米蘭·霍查1878年2月1日生於斯洛伐克蘇恰尼，1944年6月27日卒於美國克利爾沃特。他1896至1898年在布達佩斯大學攻讀法律，1900至1902年任《斯洛伐克日報》發行人兼編輯，1903至1914年任《斯洛伐克週報》負責人，1905至1910年是匈牙利議會議員；德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他是無黨籍議員。
body.en: The Czech Foreign Ministry's biographical entry records that Milan Hodža was born at Sučany in Slovakia on 1 February 1878 and died at Clearwater in the United States on 27 June 1944. He studied law at the University of Budapest in 1896-98, was publisher and editor of Slovenský denník in 1900-02 and of Slovenský týždenník in 1903-14, and sat in the Hungarian diet in 1905-10; the German National Library authority file calls him a non-party deputy.

heading.zh-Hant: 捷克斯洛伐克初期與農業黨
heading.en: Early Czechoslovakia and the Agrarian Party

body.zh-Hant: 1918年捷克斯洛伐克建國後不久，他以布拉格政府代表身分被派往布達佩斯，同年11月起與匈牙利談判匈軍撤出斯洛伐克。外交部條目說他是斯洛伐克農業黨的領導人，1918至1938年任國民議會議員，1920至1938年在該黨全國委員會任職；他先後任統一法律部長與農業部長，1926至1929年任教育部長。
body.en: Soon after Czechoslovakia was founded he was sent to Budapest as the Prague government's representative, and from November 1918 negotiated the withdrawal of Hungarian troops from Slovakia. The Foreign Ministry entries describe him as leader of the agrarian party in Slovakia, a member of the National Assembly in 1918-38 and an officer of the party's national committee in 1920-38; he served as minister for the unification of laws and minister of agriculture, and as minister of education in 1926-29.

body.zh-Hant: 1935年11月，他成為捷克斯洛伐克首位斯洛伐克裔總理。眾議院文獻記載，第一屆霍查內閣1935年11月5日任命，第二屆1935年12月18日任命、1937年7月21日總辭獲接受，第三屆1937年7月21日任命、1938年9月22日總辭獲接受。他在1935年12月18日至1936年2月29日兼管外交部，並提出以經濟合作聯結多瑙河五國的中歐計畫；1938年春他的民族地位法草案遭蘇台德德意志黨強烈反對。
body.en: In November 1935 he became the first Slovak to head the Czechoslovak government. Parliamentary records show his first cabinet appointed on 5 November 1935, his second appointed on 18 December 1935 with its resignation accepted on 21 July 1937, and his third appointed on 21 July 1937 with its resignation accepted on 22 September 1938. He also ran the Foreign Ministry from 18 December 1935 to 29 February 1936 and promoted a Central European plan tying five Danubian states together economically; his nationality statute of spring 1938 met fierce resistance from the Sudeten German Party.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年9月內閣總辭後，他於同月底前往瑞士療養，再轉往法國。1940至1944年他是倫敦國務委員會成員，1940至1941年並任副主席；1941年秋前往美國，1942年在倫敦出版《中歐聯邦》一書，闡述他的中歐聯邦構想，1944年在美國去世。
body.en: After the cabinet resigned in September 1938 he went to Switzerland for treatment at the end of the month and then to France. In 1940-44 he was a member of the State Council in London, and its deputy chairman in 1940-41; in autumn 1941 he left for the United States, where his book Federation in Central Europe (London 1942) set out his federation model, and he died in 1944.

people.name: Augustinas Voldemaras
people.nameZh: 奧古斯丁納斯·沃爾德馬拉斯

heading.en: Origins, studies and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 根據學者尤納斯·斯基里烏斯為專書撰寫的章節，奧古斯蒂納斯·沃爾德馬拉斯1883年4月16日生於施文欽尼縣，1909年畢業於聖彼得堡大學歷史語文系。1914至1917年他在義大利與瑞典進修，1917年10月出席基輔的俄羅斯各民族大會，1918年以烏克蘭代表團代表身分參與布列斯特—立陶夫斯克和談，同年7月13日被任命進入立陶宛國家委員會。
body.en: In a chapter written by the scholar Juozas Skirius, Augustinas Voldemaras was born on 16 April 1883 in the Švenčionys district and in 1909 graduated from the Faculty of History and Philology at St Petersburg University. In 1914-17 he worked in Italy and Sweden, in October 1917 took part in the Congress of Russian Nations in Kiev, in 1918 acted as representative of the Ukrainian delegation at the Brest-Litovsk peace talks, and on 13 July 1918 was appointed to the State Council of Lithuania.

body.zh-Hant: 立陶宛大百科記載，國家委員會主席團1918年11月5日邀請沃爾德馬拉斯出任總理並組閣，11月11日批准。他同時兼任外交部長；內閣重要職位多由民族進步黨黨員與親近的無黨派人士擔任。該條目指出他遲遲不建立立陶宛軍隊是最大的錯誤之一。12月20日他與財政部長前往柏林，12月24日至26日由內政部長斯塔辛斯基代行總理職務，12月26日政府不再存在。
body.en: The Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija records that on 5 November 1918 the presidium of the Council of Lithuania invited Voldemaras to become prime minister and form a government, which it approved on 11 November. He also served as foreign minister, and the leading posts went mostly to members of the National Progress Party and close non-party figures. The entry calls his delay in creating a Lithuanian army one of his greatest mistakes. On 20 December he left for Berlin with the finance minister; on 24-26 December Interior Minister Stašinskis tried to stand in for him, and on 26 December the government ceased to exist.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年12月17日政變後，沃爾德馬拉斯再度出任總理，政府任期自1926年12月17日至1929年9月19日；他向總統格里尼烏斯宣誓遵守民主的1922年憲法。1927年5月基督教民主黨籍部長辭職，形成以民族主義者為主的單一政黨政府，他同時是外交部長。1928年他與總統斯梅托納日益不和；1929年9月他赴日內瓦出席國聯理事會期間部長們向總統遞交辭呈，他拒絕留任外交部長而離開政府。
body.en: After the coup of 17 December 1926 Voldemaras became prime minister again; his government ran from 17 December 1926 to 19 September 1929, and he swore to President Grinius to uphold the democratic 1922 constitution. In May 1927 the Christian Democratic ministers resigned, leaving a one-party Nationalist government in which he was also foreign minister. In 1928 he fell increasingly out with President Smetona; in September 1929, while he was at the League of Nations Council in Geneva, the ministers handed their resignations to the president, and he refused to stay on as foreign minister and left the government.

heading.zh-Hant: 外交政策：條約與波蘭問題
heading.en: Foreign policy: treaties and the Polish question

body.zh-Hant: 斯基里烏斯的章節摘要記載，沃爾德馬拉斯任總理期間主導外交：1927年9月27日簽署與教廷的條約，1927年12月10日一項決議宣告立陶宛與波蘭之間的戰爭狀態終止，並與德國在1927至1928年間簽下九項協定；其中1928年1月25日的邊界協定使柏林承認克萊佩達地區屬於立陶宛。
body.en: The abstract of Skirius's chapter records that during his premiership Voldemaras conducted foreign policy: a treaty with the Vatican was signed on 27 September 1927; on 10 December 1927 a resolution declared the state of war between Lithuania and Poland ended; and in 1927-28 Lithuania signed nine agreements with Germany, among them the border agreement of 25 January 1928 by which Berlin recognized the Klaipėda lands as part of Lithuania.
